name: glow-hover-card
title: Glow Hover Cards
description: A grid of cards lit by one shared glow: borders and fills light up under the pointer and carry across neighbouring cards.

props.name: glowSize
props.description: Radius in pixels of the glow around the pointer.

props.name: intensity
props.description: Strength of the soft fill, 0 to 1. The glowing border is always full strength.
